name: Street ABS and ESC
source: [AS] Assists I5 part 2 / I6 (docs/next_steps_brief.md 2.2b): a generic street ABS + ESC unit. Every number is an assumption tuned on car_sedan (tests/unit/test_abs_esc.cpp): target slip 0.12 = the peak of a passenger tyre (0.10-0.15), characteristic speed 25 m/s (passenger car 20-30 m/s), lateral limit 8.5 m/s2 (~0.87 g dry), front split 0.2 growing at 0.4 1/s (split-mu yaw-moment build-up, A3), reanchor below scale 0.05, ESC brake gain 2 per rad/s capped at 0.8. No traction_control block: TC stays the car's own.
